description: This Kotlin source file defines the EditNoteActivity class, which manages creating and editing notes within an Android application. It handles user input, category selection, and interactions with the NoteRepository.

classes.name: EditNoteActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for creating or editing notes, managing UI components and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, and populates data if editing an existing note.

methods.name: setupCategories
methods.description: Loads categories into the spinner, adding a default if none exist.

methods.name: selectCategory
methods.description: Sets the spinner selection to the category of the note being edited.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including navigating back.
